02

How to work with me

1

Tell me the problem

Email a short description of what you want built or fixed, and your deadline if you have one.

2

Scope & quote

I come back with a plan, a timeline, and a fixed-scope quote or an hourly estimate.

3

Build with check-ins

I build in the open with regular updates, so you see progress and can steer it.

4

Ship & hand off

You get the working product, the source, and clear docs so your team can run it.

PassOkay

In App Store review (submitted Oct 19, 2026)

Solo designer & developer

Passport, visa, and ID photo app that checks your photo against the spec, entirely on your device.

  • Expo / React Native
  • Swift (Vision)
  • StoreKit
  • Astro
  • Node

You take or pick a photo, crop it to a document size, and get on-device checks for face, head size, centering, eyes, expression, tilt, lighting, and background. The photo never leaves the phone. A watermarked preview is free; one photo unlocks in HD for $4.99. The iPhone app uses React Native (Expo SDK 55) with native Swift Vision for the checks and StoreKit for the purchase. There's also a web version.

  • passokay.com

AwkBeats Prep Station

Released (desktop installers, v1.1.1)

Solo developer

Offline desktop catalog that imports beats, measures BPM and key on the machine, and writes the tags back into the audio files.

  • Electron
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • GitHub Actions

A desktop app for preparing a beat catalog before it goes to the store. It imports WAV, MP3, AIFF, and FLAC files or whole folders, detects tempo and musical key locally, picks up cover art that sits next to each file, and writes the metadata back into the audio. Nothing is uploaded; the library is a JSON file in the app-data folder. Built with Electron, React, and TypeScript, with installers published through GitHub Actions releases.

  • GitHub
